note: OTP Bank's Mastercard Bonus credit card (its notice in force from 15 October 2026): the main card costs 6,862 forints a year, and purchases carried past the grace period bear 2.78% a month for contracts made from that day. The first year's fee refunded on enough spending in the first two months is introductory and not written.
